title: Integrating multimodal cancer data using deep latent variable path modelling

evidence_spans.quote: We initially trained a model to map dependencies between single-nucleotide variant, methylation profiles, microRNA sequencing, RNA sequencing and histological data
using breast cancer data from The Cancer Genome Atlas

scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: This original report analyzes cancer data and does not analyze an aging construct; multi-omics is therefore not assessed under the required short-circuit.

evidence_spans.quote: trained a model to map dependencies
superior performance in mapping associations between data types

causal_design_reviewer.concise_rationale: The report applies path modelling to map dependencies and associations; it does not state directed causal semantics, a causal-effect contrast, or an intervention effect.
